Number and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs), from Day 1 through 2 weeks post-treatment.
At 48 weeks, percentage of patients with steatohepatitis improvement and no worsening of fibrosis, or fibrosis improvement by ≥1 stage and no worsening of steatohepatitis.
